chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-ʿAbbās, from Ibn Bukayr, from Ḥumrān, from Zurārah, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

ʿAlī عليه السلام gave judgment concerning a woman who committed zina, then became pregnant, and then secretly killed her child. So he ordered regarding her, and she was flogged one hundred lashes, then she was stoned, and he was the first to stone her.

key_terms.قَضَى: gave judgment; issued a judicial ruling

ai.seo_question: What was the ruling of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام for a woman who committed zina, became pregnant, and secretly killed her child?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a judicial ruling of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام in a case involving zina, pregnancy, and the secret killing of a child. It highlights the implementation of legal punishment within the justice system and preserves a precedent transmitted through the hadith tradition.
